A '''clan''' of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] existed on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] some [[Time/Legends|time]] before the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. One [[Standard day/Legends|day]], a [[Unidentified Wookiee (Attichitcuk's father's victim)|member]] of that clan was involved in a duel with [[Attichitcuk's father|another]] Wookiee, the [[Parent/Legends|father]] of [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] [[Death/Legends|died]] in the fight, which provoked a lasting enmity between his clan and the family of his killer.
